description: Landing App identity binding — the runtime mutation authority for CAS landings (migration Phase B+C). Filled in by a GitHub org admin AFTER creating the GitHub App (user/org-admin action — an agent cannot create Apps via gh). The Landing App is the ONLY authority that mutates refs/heads/main via the updateRefs CAS path; this file is on the merge-admission trust surface, so a PR changing it denies auto-merge until manually re-reviewed.
notes: Do NOT edit app_id/installation_id/webhook_secret_ref by hand-guessing — fill from the org-level App creation result + gh api installation query (checklist in the Phase B+C delivery report).
status transitions: PENDING_APP_CREATION -> READY when app_id + installation_id are populated by the admin; the Landing App CLI fails closed on any non-READY status.
webhook_secret_ref: fill with the secret-name reference used by the out-of-repo webhook bridge (never the secret value).
pinned_deploy_commit: the main-SHA the App's landing code is pinned to (deployment pinning; filled at first deploy).
